SolarFlex Titan 20K: Infinite Power, On The Go

Harness the power of the sun with the SolarFlex Titan 20K. This rugged, 20,000mAh foldable solar power bank is your ultimate companion for hiking, camping, and any off-grid adventure. With high-efficiency solar panels and fast-charging ports, you'll never have to worry about a dead battery again.

Your Adventure, Powered by the Sun

The SolarFlex Titan 20K is engineered for the ultimate outdoor enthusiast. It combines a high-capacity 20,000mAh battery with four high-efficiency foldable solar panels, ensuring you have a limitless supply of power for all your devices, no matter how far you roam.

High-Efficiency Solar Charging

Four foldable solar panels capture maximum sunlight to rapidly recharge the 20,000mAh battery on the go.

Built for the Outdoors

A rugged, weather-resistant design ensures the power bank can handle the demands of any adventure, rain or shine.

Fast-Charging Ports

Dual USB-A and a powerful USB-C port allow for simultaneous, high-speed charging of multiple devices like phones, tablets, and cameras.
